notes.title: First patch of the year!
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay & Mechanics[/b]

*   [b]Mines Rework:[/b]
    *   Detection: Now uses a box trace instead of a sphere trace.
    *   Damage: Detects hits on different body parts, with damage accumulating based on the number of parts hit.
    *   Base Damage: 100 -> 25 (Requires hits on 4 of 8 body parts at close range for a kill).
    *   Damage Radius: 4 meters -> 8 meters.
    *   Minimum Damage: 10.
    *   Damage Falloff: Linear falloff with distance (0 damage at 8 meters, minimum 10 damage).

*   [b]Reflex Learning:[/b]
    *   Passively reloads the stowed weapon.
    *   Reload Amount: 1 bullet per second.

*  [b] Lazer Dot[/b] (We spell laser with a z sometimes because it's cool)
    *   Toggles on/off based on player state (QOL improvement).
    *   Gun animation kick reduced by 75% when using the Lazer Dot (visual improvement; recoil multiplier remains 0.25).
    *   Accuracy: Now completely accurate (may be reverted).
    *   Visibility: No longer visible through walls to other players.
    *   Ballpoint: Visible to other players.
    *   Ballpoint Scaling: Size scales with distance.

*   [b]Mimic & Cloak[/b]:
    *   Mimic: Grants immunity to cameras and detection lasers.
    *   Cloak: Grants immunity to cameras (but not detection lasers).

*   [b]Vision Modes[/b]
    *   Fixed a bug where dying with vision modes active would cause them to persist indefinitely.

*   [b]Hacking[/b]:
    *   Fixed multiple bugs preventing re-hacking of hacked objectives.
    *   Fixed a bug where the hacking objective percentage UI would get stuck.
    *   Hacking now cancels upon movement, no longer requiring interaction.

*   [b]Spectre:[/b]
    *   Added "WallRun" keybind (functions as before: hold and run into a wall).
    *   Shoulder Swap: Can now swap shoulders while crouching.
    *   Default Shoulder Swap Keys: Alt + Q and Alt + R (previously Q and E).

*   [b]Reaper:[/b]
    *   Added Reaper spawn system.
    *   If "UseGadget" button is different from "Fire" button, pressing "Fire" will exit gadget mode and fire the weapon.

[b]Weapon Balancing[/b]

*   [b]Shotgun:[/b]
    *   Pellet Damage: 10 -> 20.
    *   Headshot Multiplier: 5 -> 6.

*   [b]AR:[/b]
    *   Bullet Damage: 12 -> 20.
    *   Minimum Possible Damage: 5 -> 7.5.
    *   Minimum Possible Headshot Damage: 30 -> 35.
    *   Damage Reduction per Meter: 0.2 -> 0.15.
    *   Distance until headshot damage reduction activates (clarify this point in future notes).

*   [b]SMG:[/b]
    *   Bullet Damage: 15 -> 20.
    *   Headshot Damage: 20 -> 25.
    *   Minimum Possible Damage: 3 -> 5.
    *   Minimum Possible Headshot Damage: 7 -> 15.
    *   Damage Reduction per Meter: 0.6 -> 0.8.
    *   Headshot Damage Reduction Per Meter: 1.0 (Unchanged).

*   [b]Reaper Grenade:[/b]
    *   Base Explosion Damage: 100 -> 150.
    *   Minimum Explosion Damage: 10 (Unchanged).
    *   Explosion Radius: 8 -> 16 meters.
    *   Detonation Time: 5 -> 3.5 seconds.
[b]
UI/UX & Quality of Life[/b]

*   [b]Loadouts:[/b]
    *   Fixed a bug causing weapon mods to be continuously deleted while still showing as selected.
    *   Fixed a crash when selecting too many gadgets.
    *   Loadout Selection Logic: Now attempts to load in this order: Last Used -> Loadout 1 -> Loadout 2 -> Loadout 3 -> Default.

*   [b]Reticle:[/b]
    *   Reticle color preview added to loadout.
    *   Reticle settings are now saved.
    *   Improved Reticle section UI in the Reaper loadout.
    *   Reticle/Lazer color can now be updated and saved even without the weapon selected.
    *   Other QOL improvements to reticle and color changes.

*   [b]Lazer Dot:[/b] Fixed a bug causing two lazers to appear.
*   Mines: Fixed a bug where only the server could see and hear planted mines.
*   Loading Screen: Added loading screen.
*   Death UI: Overhauled Death UI.

*   [b]Input Settings:[/b]
    *   Menu button now has a mandatory binding.
    *   Fixed a bug where some input settings weren't displaying.
    *   Resetting Reaper/Spectre input settings now maintains alphabetical order.

*   [b]Other:[/b]
    *   Updated description of Reflex Learning Condition.

notes.title: Patch 0.6.3.0 Weapon Mod Update
notes.content:
Weapon Mod Update

[b]Muzzlebreak[/b]
- Muzzlebreak Recoil Reduction: 0.5 -> 0.65
- Updated Muzzlebreak UI info from "will reduce recoil massively" to "will reduce recoil considerably"

Developer Thoughts: Currently there's no reason not to take Muzzlebreak, it's good in every situation, and has nonexistent tradeoffs. It's still very good, just slightly less good.

[b]Laser Dot[/b]
- New: Lazer Dot Weapon Mod
- Laser Dot Recoil reduction when hipfiring: 0.3 (It grants no benefits for ADS)
- Laser Dot color matches reticle color
- Laser can be toggled on and off with C key (Rebindable) (Turning Off the laser will also disable the recoil effects)
- Laser Dot reduces gun bounce when shooting (this may potentially be turned into an overall effect scaled by total recoil instead of just a laser dot benefit)
- Laser can be seen by other players
- Laser does not turn off upon switching weapons (may be removed in future patch)

Developer Thoughts: In our continuous efforts to promote different playstyles and diversity, we felt like laser dots would be a great implementation. This is a great choice for hip firing, and further increases lethality at up close and medium range. Try picking the Laser Dot if you're looking to do some serious damage by beaming your opponents, no pun intended.

[b]Tracer Rounds[/b]
- New: Tracer Rounds Bullet Mod
- Tracer Rounds will appear as a projectile every 3 bullets fired (they do not apply additional damage)
- Tracer Rounds will cause a bullet sound audio effect upon just missing you (it sounds like fewwwm, whoosh, zshoom)
- Tracer Rounds are visible to everyone
- Tracer rounds unlock hit marker sound effects and visuals (we are very interested in ideas on what visuals this could also unlock, let us know if you have any ideas)
- Tracer Rounds unlock fear in your enemies

Developer Thoughts: Tracer Rounds, the bullet choice for maximum clarity. We plan to experiment and find more creative ways for tracer rounds to benefit the reaper through abstract methods. Think of this as an information gathering tool

notes.title: Patch 0.6.1.0 Spectre Locomotion Update
notes.content:
[u]Patch 0.6.1.0[/u]

[b]Spectre Locomotion changes[/b]
- Spectre hands trace downward to touch object distance: 50cm -> 100cm (This allows you to snap to the object 50cm sooner)
- Spectre hands hitbox to touch object: 6cm sphere -> 20cm (Both hands hitboxes need to be touching the object in order to grab it)
- Spectre reach up height 95cm -> 100cm (pretend you're 200cm tall, if you put your arms in the air you can reach the top of a 205cm wall and climb it)
- NEW: Spectre running reach up height 95cm -> 130cm ( this isn't as big of an increase as it initially seems, due to the way the movement system works, when running you actually had a lower jump velocity then if you were standing still. So if the default was 95cm, you could only reach 85cm when running. You could consider that a bug. Anyway, you can actually have a better chance at reaching a tall object if you're at max speed)
- Spectre Air Control: 0.1 -> 1.0 (This respects momentum, trying to jump around to do sick bullet dodges will most likely get you killed. Often times spectre's were just barely missing the range required to snap onto the wall, If you were running parrellel to a wall you were less likely to wall grab because of being just slightly out of reach. this air control change allows them to push slightly further to reach the wall when in the air, which should result in more successful climbs attempts.

[i]Notes: Currently climbing and latching onto objects don't feel great. A lot of the time you won't latch onto something you felt like you should have, and it feels bad especially when you're being gunned down. These changes should allow for more responsive, reliable latches. you still need to reasonably position yourself, but the system overall will do a much better job letting you do what you were intending to do.[/i]

[b]Optimization Changes[/b]

General
- Continued to correct/optimize materials throughout game.
- Updated character highlight (now only shows when player is occluded).
- Reduced intensity of character highlight.
- Adjusted the properties of the new glass system.
- fixed the bullet casings texture issue on main menu
- Placed Environment Mod explosive locations across all maps (When you interact with a tablet to breach a door or vent, the explosion is where it's supposed to be and not at the tablet)
- Corrected UI issue where selected weapons in Loadout had white background


Frost
- Corrected wonky textures in the Frostbite spawn
- Replaced snow particles (Still having issues on DX11)
- Replaced inefficient particle system in Main building.
- Replaced repeated meshes with instanced static meshes (Optimization)
 +Server Boxes
 + Fences
 + Catwalks

Jungle
- Replaced repeated meshes with instanced static meshes (Optimization)
 + Catwalks
 + Catwalk support
- Replaced inefficient particle systems, removed others

Yard
- Replaced repeated meshes with instanced static meshes (Optimization)
 + Perimeter fencing
 + Background Meshes
 + Fencing in Processing area
 + Racks and assets in Inventory area
 + Shipping containers in Storage area
 + Subfloor units across map

notes.title: Patch 0.6.0 Controls update
notes.content:
This patch brings us to a new milestone where we've changed a pretty important system. Control settings have been completely reconsidered, a lot has changed keybind wise, and reaper get much more control over what buttons they want to use. There is also a new way to swap between gadgets, via the gadget wheel. I won't list all of the keybind changes here, please check them out in the keybind settings!

Removed the scroll wheel gadget switcher in replace of the Gadget wheel.
Revamped default keys for reaper and spectre to be more up to date with fps shooter controls
Equipping Passive Gadgets no longer stop you from running
fixed a bug where reapers movement detection pulse sound would persist through electro vision

mines will be canceled when running
mines will be canceled upon opening gadget wheel

Added action key categories (All, General, Reaper, And Spectre)

notes.title: Patch 0.5.5.6 Gun Update!
notes.content:
[b]AR Changes 1/3[/b]

BaseDamage: 30 -> 12 (Now takes 9 shots to kill a spectre upclose instead of only 4)
New: HeadshotDamage: 100

New: Bullet Damage Reduction Per Meter: 0.2 (this means for every meter the bullet will do 0.2 less damage)
New: Headshot Bullet Damage Reduction Per Meter: 4
New: Headshot Bullet Damage FallOff At Distance: 25 (this means headshots won't accumulate falloff damage until after 25 meters, Example: 26 meters would do 99.8 damage)
New: Minimum Possible Damage: 5
New: Minimum Possible Headshot Damage: 30

Upclose shots to kill: 4 -> 9
Shots to kill past 15m: 4 -> 13

Headshots To Kill before 25m: 1
Headshots to kill before 36m: 2
Headshots to kill before 41m: 3
Headshots to kill after 40m: 4

Notes: Right now the only correct gun to use is the AR, With no bullet drop, only 4 shots to kill, and an instant kill headshot, along with attachments, least recoil, etc. You were actually putting yourself at an all around disadvantage using anything else. These changes aim to entice you to switch to your secondary weapon for faster kill potential when a spectre is nearby. It also aims to discourage camping the best area on the map for easy hotshot insta kills. (The AR is not a sniper... but potentially we could add a sniper to the game if needed). Finally we want the AR to be a good choice in all situations, just not the best choice in all situations.

[b]SMG Changes 2/3[/b]
BaseDamage: 18 -> 15
New: Headshot Damage: 20

Automatic Speed: 0.1 -> 0.05 (it spits bullets out twice as fast)
Magizine Capacity: 20 -> 30

New: Bullet Damage Reduction Per Meter: 0.6
New: Headshot Damage Reduction Per Meter: 0.6

New: Minimum Possible Damage: 3
New: Minimum Possible Headshot Damage: 7

Notes: This gun really hurts upclose, and doesn't depend on headshots for fast kills like the other guns. Good recoil management is key with this gun. It has the fastest kill time at medium and short ranges excluding headshots. (though headshotting will still kill about 1.5x times faster assuming every bullet landed) This gun has insane fall off damage, and unlike the shotgun Aiming down sights won't help much landing your shots due to the high recoil. 

[b]Shotgun Changes 3/3[/b]

Shotgun Pellet damage: 8 -> 10
Shotgun Pellets per shot 7 -> 8
Shotgun spread 2 -> 2.5
ShotgunSpread hipfire: 2.5 -> 3.0
Removed: 5 Shotgun pellet hits required to be considered a headshot
NEW: ShotgunSpread aiming: 1.5
New: Shotgun headshot pellet damage multiplier: 5
New: Shotgun pellet damage reduction per meter (also reduces headshot damage): 1

Notes: These changes will help the shotgun standout as a strong upclose weapon, while also doing good chip damage from a medium range. Barrel stuffing a spectre with a shotgun will require two shots minimum unless atleast one pellet hit their head. This change makes it so that the SMG will provide the fastest nonheadshot killtime upclose for bodyshots. The shotgun should be a great weapon upclose even without having to aim, but it became rapidly unusable and luck based the further the player got due to the randomness of the pellets, and falloff damage. Accurately aimed shots should feel rewarding and not so dependent on pellets deciding to hit or miss the target

Reposted shotgun changes so you can see all the changes in one post.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.5.5
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where spectre's aim would sometimes be off
The game remembers and automatically sets your last used loadout
Rejoining a game will now load your last used loadout, or default loadout
Improved default loadout to have attachments, and better begginer gadgets and edges

Cloak Adjustments

New: Minimum Cloak Time: 0.75 (cloak will not deactivate for any reason until after 0.75 seconds of activating)
New: Cloak Cooldown: 4 seconds

Notes: The cloak adjustments was not meant to be a buff or a nerf. If this change becomes problematic we will adjust it quickly. This change addressed an issue where it could be spammed without fail to drop framerates of everyone nearby. You could use it to lower the frames of the reaper shooting you for a nasty advantage. The minimum cloak time is to help cases where you accidentally moved too quickly after cloaking and became uncloaked. Now if you accidentally uncloak yourself and have to wait out the 4 seconds you only have yourself to blame. (The cloak cooldown starts at the time of the cloak starting, not upon ending. So it is possible to use the cloak again directly after uncloaking)
